verdict.rationale: Abacum documents scenarios (base, bull and bear) built off the same base version, with assumptions held in a governed workspace. It also documents a detailed edit history covering every edit event on data models and spaces, which supports auditability. The docs do not explicitly tie that history to individual scenarios, show which user made each change, or describe an auditable side-by-side scenario comparison. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption logs, user attribution of changes, an auditable scenario-comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each scenario records its assumptions and who changed them, so a comparison is auditable

citations.quote: you can maintain a detailed history, offering full visibility into every edit event on your data models, spaces, or dimension mappings.
Build base, bull and bear off the same base version. Change an assumption and watch revenue, hiring and cash move together.
Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace
